items.rss_summary: Jane Harman, former California Democratic congresswoman, said the US war in Iran has made every country in the Middle East a target, even countries that have not yet been participants in the conflict. Harman said that the danger of the conflict spreading is  'huge' and the US defense industrial base may not be prepared to address conflicts worldwide.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.rss_summary: Fighting between the US and Iran has resumed after a brief lull, with American strikes focused on military targets and Tehran-aligned forces targeting US partners in the region. Israel has so far remained outside the latest exchange of strikes following Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s in-person talks with President Donald Trump. Bloomberg’s Dan Williams reports from Washington, DC. (Source: Bloomberg)
